# Portfolix v0.1.8 (Build 19)
## 新功能与改进
- 数据备份现已包含风险偏好资料，同时继续排除 API Key 等敏感信息；导入后每日盈亏和风险画像会立即恢复。 - 全面优化界面渲染与数据计算性能，减少大规模持仓、图表和 Agent 历史消息滚动时的卡顿。 - 修复 Agent 聊天记录在快速滚动时偶发消失、输入焦点丢失及输入延迟的问题。 - 智能分析改用外部联网搜索，支持免密钥的 Parallel Search，并可同时配置 Tavily 与博查作为搜索来源和回退方案。 - Agent 现在可以根据问题选择搜索服务、回答报告范围之外的问题，并在回答中提供可点击的网页引用。 - 改进 DeepSeek 模型兼容性、上下文管理、思考状态展示、响应校验和运行诊断。 - 优化 DeepSeek 与搜索 API 配置体验，支持直接编辑或删除已保存的 API Key，并统一配置状态反馈。 - 重新调整浅色与深色模式的背景、卡片边界和侧边栏选中状态，使界面更清晰一致。
## New Features and Improvements
- Backups now include risk preferences while continuing to exclude API keys and other sensitive data. Daily profit history and the risk profile are restored immediately after import. - Improved UI rendering and portfolio analytics performance to reduce stutter with large portfolios, charts, and long Agent conversations. - Fixed Agent messages occasionally disappearing during fast scrolling, input focus loss, and composer typing latency. - Replaced retired model-provided web search with external search services: keyless Parallel Search plus optional Tavily and Bocha providers with fallback support. - The Agent can now choose an appropriate search provider, answer questions beyond the generated report, and attach clickable web citations to supported claims. - Improved DeepSeek model compatibility, context management, thinking-state presentation, response validation, and runtime diagnostics. - Refined DeepSeek and Search API configuration, including direct editing or deletion of saved API keys and consistent configuration feedback. - Rebalanced light and dark appearance colors, card borders, and sidebar selection styling for a cleaner and more consistent interface.
